notes.title: CHRISTMAS UPDATE
notes.content:
In the spirit of the holiday, we bring you plenty of goodies. There are new Christmas levels, new achievement (and some of the old ones fixed and provided with description), and trading cards are well on the way.

Have fun and happy holidays! ːsteamhappyː

http://www.phime.com/files/dalehd/social/christmas_update.jpg
